name: opus-video-studio
description: Code-driven UI motion and product videos, with managed Opus video and audio generation.

interface.shortDescription: Create UI motion, video, and audio with Opus.
interface.longDescription: Opus Video Tools combines editable local UI motion and product videos with approved managed video and audio generation. Motion UI follows your product interface and chosen framework; Seedance Director plans generated video clips. Reuse an existing project or start a local Remotion project without a gallery template.
defaultPrompt: Use Motion UI to create a launch video based on my product’s real interface.
Use Seedance Director to create a video from this brief and reference image.
